## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; names, addresses and credentials are the demo's made-up ones
- [ ] `dist/` and `docs/_generated/` regenerated with `uv run demo-gen` (never edited by hand)
- [ ] Documentation updated: the README, `docs/walkthrough.md` or `docs/troubleshooting.md` where what a user sees or runs changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, and a breaking change is marked (`!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)
- [ ] No secret, token or password reaches a log line, an error message or a committed file
- [ ] New files carry an SPDX header (`reuse lint` is clean)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
